title: Follow up on FP-1: 1 minor finding(s)?
body:
FP-1 shipped with 1 minor finding(s) still open:

- Edge case not covered by design (`/Users/naveensakhamuri/IdeaProjects/foreman-proof-node-1/.foreman/worktrees/w1/sum.mjs:89`): clamp(-0, 0, 10) returns -0, because -0 < 0 is false so the value passes through. This matches common clamp behaviour (Math.min/Math.max style) and the story says nothing about signed zero — fix: None needed. Note it only if the project later wants signed-zero normalisation

"Create a follow-up story" adds a story, "Follow-ups from FP-1", to fix them.
